name: get_form_context
description: Read the active recorder draft and basic shift field definitions. Call at session start. Review & confirm opens the saved note and a silent risk check; AI2 does not ask questions.

name: get_participant_context
description: Read the current participant's saved profile background and up to two recent confirmed shift records, with dated sources and confirmed follow-up. Call after get_form_context at session start, and again after saving the actual shift start or correcting it. Use history only to understand the worker's account and ask relevant current updates; never copy it into this shift as new facts. The app selects the participant and checks access. No parameters are needed.

name: update_and_check_form
description: Save supported changes to the basic shift account and wait for validation. Preserve factual observations, uncertainty, exact quotes and reference codes. This does not complete the note.

fields_json.description: JSON object with a fields object containing only changed shiftStart, shiftEnd, activities, supportProvided, participantResponse or goalProgress. Preserve reported concerns in the narrative. Never include incident classification, field_states, restrictive_practice, question_updates or participant changes.
